notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.3.1.4 Prologue Demo
notes.content:
[p]English[/p][p][b]Patch Notes - Version 0.3.1.4[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved fluidity of [b]Charge Attack[/b] animations and responsiveness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Perfect Dodge[/b] now allows follow-up [b]Charge Attacks[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Language options have been reduced to [b]Thai, Chinese, English, and Japanese[/b] for better clarity and performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted certain [b]camera angles[/b] for better gameplay visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where [b]textures appeared blurry[/b] in some graphic settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved missing [b]SFX[/b] in specific scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could get [b]stuck on walls during Wall Run[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]DualSense (PS5) controller[/b] is now fully supported.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]ไทย[/p][p][b]Patch Note - Burning Sword: Death Sun[/b]
[b]Version 0.3.1.4[/b][/p][list][*][p]ปรับการเคลื่อนไหวของ [b]Charge Attack[/b] ให้ลื่นไหลมากยิ่งขึ้น[/p][/*][*][p][b]Perfect Dodge[/b] สามารถกดชาร์จโจมตีต่อได้ทันที[/p][/*][*][p]ลดจำนวนภาษาในเกม เหลือเพียง: [b]ไทย / จีน / อังกฤษ / ญี่ปุ่น[/b][/p][/*][*][p]ปรับปรุงมุมกล้องบางจุดให้ดีขึ้น[/p][/*][*][p]แก้ไขปัญหา [b]Texture ละลาย[/b] ในหน้าการตั้งค่า[/p][/*][*][p]แก้ไขปัญหาเสียง [b]SFX บางจุดหายไป[/b][/p][/*][*][p]แก้บัคติดกำแพงในขณะ [b]Wall Run[/b][/p][/*][*][p]รองรับการใช้งานจอย [b]DualSense[/b] แล้ว[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Play Prologue Demo Now!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="j7KyW_46P94;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]These are the trials that await in the Prologue Demo.[/b][/p][list][*][p]In the prologue, [b]Zhang Yixian[/b], the Crimsondust Demon Sect Master, has finally arrived at the gates of [b]Gao Tianqi [/b]to settle an old and deadly score. But the path to vengeance is filled with relentless trials and powerful enemies. He must fight his way through countless obstacles to confront Gao Tianqi and bring their long-standing feud to an end.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Face off against three formidable martial artists[/b]—each battle a brutal test of skill with no mercy given. Fight until your last breath. You must [b]master every move[/b], [b]learn quickly[/b], and [b]immerse yourself in the martial world[/b] if you hope to survive.[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese Martial Arts. In the game, you shall encounter martial techniques and inner energy arts inspired by the golden era of 90s wuxia tales. Prepare to be immersed in a thrilling, elegant, and fluid combat experience. You must memorize and master each technique, adapting your style to match both the situation and your foes.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Burning Sword[/b] is the core of your power in the game. When you gather and release it, your attacks become more powerful and give you a greater advantage. Every enemy fears the deadly moves of the [b]Burning Sword[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]In this world, the challenge stays the same for all — there is no difficulty setting. But do not worry, falling in battle brings no punishment. So keep training, learn your moves well, and use them wisely to defeat every enemy that stands in your way.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill Tree: You will be able to learn the martial arts that Zhang Yixian can use, including combo techniques and powerful skills that can be unleashed. Some of these arts require the use of Qi. Therefore, study and master them well before going out to test your skills in the martial world.[/p][/*][*][p]Qi (Inner Energy) You can use skills powered by your Qi and even shoot Qi at enemies to gain an advantage in battle. But beware — your Qi is limited. Use it wisely, if you push it too far and run out, it will drain your life.[/p][/*][*][p]The Qi Drain Technique is a forbidden secret skill that steals the life and Qi from your enemies to strengthen yourself.[/p][/*][*][p]Lightness Skill (Qinggong) During your journey, you will be able to climb walls and float through the air like a martial hero. This lets you reach places that ordinary people cannot.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebound: Use the objects around you to your advantage in battle. You can use your martial arts to forcefully push items toward your enemies, creating an opportunity for your next attack.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list]

Hey, the martial arts masters!
The Alpha Demo has ended — but it’s just the beginning. The real challenge awaits.
Prepare yourself for the battles ahead, as powerful martial artists and ruthless sect leaders close in to take your life.
Survive the chaos and hunt down Gao Tianqi. ⚔️ 🔥 

See you at Steam Next Fest 2025, from June 9th to 16th!
